## source

### `source.list`

List everything with editable text (HTML, CSS, Markdown, plugin code) and its target id.

Covers sidebar tabs, status widgets, block and page types, CSS snippets, component styles, Home widgets/views and plugins. Use the target with source.get / source.edit (plugins: plugins.edit).

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `SourceEntry[]` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"sidebar" \| "status" \| "block" \| "node" \| "css" \| "component" \| "home" \| "homeview" \| "plugin"` |  | Only this kind. |

### `source.get`

Read the current text of a target (e.g. a widget's HTML) before editing it.

Pass startLine/endLine to read part of a long file. Fields: sidebar html|markdown, status html|text, block/node html, css css, component css|rules, home html|css|text, homeview css, plugin code|styles.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `{ target: string; owner: string; field: string; lines: number; length: number; text: string }` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `string` | yes | Target from source.list, e.g. status:pomodoro, home:<viewId>/<widgetId>, plugin:<id>. |
| `field` | `string` |  | Which text (defaults to the main one). |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Layer id when the same id exists in several layers. |
| `startLine` | `number` |  | First line (1-based). |
| `endLine` | `number` |  | Last line. |

### `source.edit`

Change part of a widget, tab, block/page type, CSS or Home widget by find-and-replace.

Read it with source.get first; each find must match exactly once (whitespace differences tolerated) unless all: true. Edits apply in order and are all-or-nothing. Far cheaper than resending the whole HTML with setWidget/setTab/registerType — use it for every change to something that exists. Plugin code: use plugins.edit.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `{ target: string; field: string; replaced: number; length: number; owner?: string }` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `string` | yes | Target from source.list. |
| `field` | `string` |  | Which text (defaults to the main one). |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Layer id when ambiguous. |
| `edits` | `{ /** Exact text to replace (include enough context to be unique). */ find: string; /** Replacement text ("" deletes). */ replace: string; /** Replace every occurrence. */ all?: boolean; }[]` | yes | Edits, applied in order. |

## plugins

### `plugins.list`

List installed plugins.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginInfo[]` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `plugins.getSource`

Read an installed plugin's manifest, code and styles.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginSourceInfo` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |

### `plugins.edit`

Change an installed plugin's code or styles by find-and-replace, then test and reinstall it.

Read it with plugins.getSource (or source.get plugin:<id>) first. The patch version is bumped automatically. Can also update permissions or description. Same test run and health check as plugins.create.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginInstallResult & { version: string; replaced: number }` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `file` | `"code" \| "styles"` |  | Which file the edits change. Default `"code"`. |
| `edits` | `{ /** Exact text to replace (include enough context to be unique). */ find: string; /** Replacement text ("" deletes). */ replace: string; /** Replace every occurrence. */ all?: boolean; }[]` |  | Edits, applied in order. |
| `permissions` | `string[]` |  | Replace the permission list. |
| `description` | `string` |  | New description. |
| `version` | `string` |  | Explicit new version (default: bump patch). |
| `skipTest` | `boolean` |  | Install even if the test run reports errors. Default `false`. |

### `plugins.create`

Install (or update) a plugin written by the assistant. The user reviews the code and permissions first.

code is plain JavaScript run in a sandbox. It must call Noteral.register(class extends Noteral.Plugin { async onload() {…} onunload() {…} }). Use this.app.<namespace>.<method>(params) for every App API method (e.g. this.app.sidebar.setTab, this.app.statusBar.setWidget, this.app.blocks.registerType, this.app.nodes.registerType, this.app.home.addWidget), this.addCommand({ id, title, run }), this.setStatus(itemId, text), this.setPanel(panelId, { title, markdown, actions }), this.onPanelAction(panelId, fn), this.onViewMessage(fn), this.registerEvent(eventName, fn), this.addStyles(css), this.loadData() / this.saveData(patch). The plugin is test-run first (see plugins.test) and, after installing, its start-up is checked: the result's `health` reports errors so you can fix and reinstall.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginInstallResult` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `{ /** Reverse-DNS id, e.g. com.assistant.word-goal. */ id: string; /** Name. */ name: string; /** Semver, e.g. 1.0.0. */ version: string; /** What it does. */ description: string; /** Permissions the code needs. */ permissions?: string[]; /** Commands it adds. */ commands?: { /** Command id (lowercase, dashes). */ id: string; /** Title. */ title: string; }[]; /** Status bar items. */ statusItems?: { /** Item id. */ id: string; /** Label. */ label: string; }[]; /** Sidebar panels. */ panels?: { /** Panel id. */ id: string; /** Title. */ title: string; }[]; }` | yes |  |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Plugin JavaScript. |
| `styles` | `string` |  | Optional CSS (needs ui.styles). |
| `skipTest` | `boolean` |  | Install even if the test run reports errors. Default `false`. |

### `plugins.test`

Run plugin code in a throw-away sandbox without installing it, and report errors, logs, commands and UI it registered.

Write calls (except UI registration) are skipped during the test. Always test before plugins.create and fix every reported error.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginTestResult` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `{ /** Plugin id. */ id: string; /** Name. */ name: string; /** Version. */ version?: string; /** Permissions. */ permissions?: string[]; }` | yes |  |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Plugin JavaScript. |
| `styles` | `string` |  | CSS. |
| `waitMs` | `number` |  | How long to watch it (ms). Default `1500`. |

### `plugins.logs`

Read an installed plugin's recent errors, warnings and console output.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `LogEntryInfo[]` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Entries. Default `50`. |

### `plugins.uninstall`

Uninstall a plugin.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |

### `plugins.setEnabled`

Enable or disable an installed plugin.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | yes | Enabled. |

## Events

Subscribe with `this.registerEvent(name, handler)`. Events are only computed while someone listens.

| Event | Payload | Permission | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document:changed` | `EditorSnapshot` | `editor.read` | The open page changed (debounced). Payload is the editor snapshot. |
| `page:opened` | `ActivePage \| null` | none | A different page (or Home) became active. |
| `theme:changed` | `{ theme: "light" \| "dark" }` | none | Light/dark theme changed. |
| `workspace:opened` | `WorkspaceInfo` | none | A workspace was opened. |
| `selection:changed` | `EditorSelection & { pageId: string }` | `editor.read` | The cursor or selection moved in the open page (debounced). |
| `layout:changed` | `LayoutInfo` | `layout` | Panes, tabs, sidebars or their tabs changed (debounced). |
| `pages:changed` | `{ count: number }` | `pages.read` | Pages were created, renamed, moved or trashed. |
| `panel:action` | `{ panelId: string; actionId: string }` | `ui.panel` | A button in one of the plugin's panels or Markdown tabs was pressed. |
| `settings:changed` | `{ options: Record<string, unknown>; changed: string[] }` | `settings.read` | The user changed the plugin's options. |
| `view:message` | `{ view: string; name: string; payload: unknown }` | none | One of the plugin's HTML views called noteral.post(name, payload). |

## Permissions

| Permission | Risk | Grants |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `editor.read` | low | **Read the open page.** Read the text, blocks and selection of the page you are editing. |
| `editor.write` | medium | **Edit the open page.** Insert, change and remove blocks in the page you are editing. |
| `pages.read` | medium | **Read pages.** List pages and read the content of any page in the workspace. |
| `pages.write` | high | **Change pages.** Create, rename, move, rewrite and trash pages. |
| `databases.read` | medium | **Read databases.** Read database schemas and rows. |
| `databases.write` | high | **Change databases.** Create databases, add properties and add or edit rows. |
| `navigation` | low | **Navigate.** Open pages, go back and forward, open Home. |
| `search.read` | medium | **Search.** Run full-text searches across the workspace. |
| `ui.status` | low | **Status bar.** Show text and widgets in the status bar. |
| `ui.notify` | low | **Notifications.** Show toast notifications. |
| `ui.panel` | low | **Sidebar tabs.** Add tabs to the right sidebar. |
| `ui.modal` | low | **Dialogs.** Ask you to confirm, type an answer or pick from a list. |
| `ui.styles` | medium | **Plugin styles.** Add CSS to the app (for the plugin's own look). |
| `settings.read` | low | **Read its settings.** Read the plugin's own saved settings. |
| `settings.write` | low | **Save its settings.** Save the plugin's own settings. |
| `assets.read` | low | **Read files.** Read images and files attached to pages. |
| `assets.write` | low | **Import files.** Ask you to pick an image or file and import it. |
| `workspaces.read` | low | **See workspaces.** List workspaces and see which one is open. |
| `workspaces.write` | high | **Manage workspaces.** Create, rename and switch workspaces. |
| `layout` | low | **Layout.** Split panes, arrange sidebar tab groups, show or hide sidebars and resize panels. |
| `appearance` | medium | **Appearance.** Change colors, fonts and component styles across the app. |
| `preferences` | medium | **Preferences.** Read and change app preferences such as theme and font size. |
| `commands.execute` | high | **Run commands.** Run any command from the command palette. |
| `clipboard` | medium | **Clipboard.** Read and write the clipboard. |
| `network` | high | **Internet access.** Make web requests, search the web and fetch pages. |
| `blocks` | low | **Custom blocks.** Add new kinds of blocks to the editor (rendered in a sandbox). |
| `nodes` | low | **Custom page types.** Add new kinds of items to the page tree (rendered in a sandbox). |
| `home` | medium | **Home.** Create, change and remove Home views and widgets. |
| `menus` | low | **Menu items.** Add items to page, tree, block, tab and status bar menus. |

## Types

Return types, as shipped in `@noteral/sdk` (`sdk/src/types.ts`).

```ts
export interface AppInfo {
  appName: string;
  appVersion: string;
  sdkVersion: string;
  platform: string;
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  workspaceId: string | null;
}

export interface ActivePage {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  paneId: string;
  /** True when the page is open in a live editor (editor.* methods work on it). */
  editable: boolean;
}

export interface BlockSummary {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  text: string;
  props?: Record<string, unknown>;
  children?: BlockSummary[];
}

export interface EditorSelection {
  text: string;
  blockIds: string[];
  cursorBlockId: string;
}

/** One block from editor.getBlock: the summary plus where it sits. */
export interface BlockDetail extends BlockSummary {
  /** Parent block id ("" at the top level). */
  parentId: string;
  /** Previous sibling id ("" when first). */
  prevId: string;
  /** Next sibling id ("" when last). */
  nextId: string;
}

export interface OutlineItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  level: number;
}

export interface EditorSnapshot {
  pageId: string;
  title: string;
  wordCount: number;
  blockCount: number;
  text: string;
  outline: OutlineItem[];
}

/** Content facts about a page (pages.stats). Database pages also get `database`. */
/** A page's background (behind the whole page, not the cover). */
export interface PageBackgroundInfo {
  kind: "color" | "gradient" | "image" | "ascii";
  value?: string;
  ascii?: { scene: string; speed?: number; ink?: string; density?: "fine" | "normal" | "large"; still?: boolean; cursor?: boolean };
  opacity?: number;
  dim?: number;
}

export interface PageStats {
  pageId: string;
  title: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  icon: string;
  parentId: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  /** 0 for top-level pages. */
  depth: number;
  childPages: number;
  favorite: boolean;
  /** The page is the one in focus. */
  active: boolean;
  /** Counted from the open editor (includes unsaved edits). */
  open: boolean;
  words: number;
  characters: number;
  charactersNoSpaces: number;
  blocks: number;
  paragraphs: number;
  lines: number;
  blockTypes: Record<string, number>;
  headings: { level: number; text: string; blockId: string }[];
  todos: { total: number; done: number; open: number };
  links: { url: string; text: string }[];
  pageLinks: { pageId: string; title: string }[];
  databases: { id: string; title: string; blockId: string }[];
  customBlocks: { kind: string; count: number }[];
  images: number;
  media: number;
  files: number;
  tables: number;
  codeBlocks: number;
  quotes: number;
  readingMinutes: number;
  speakingMinutes: number;
  database?: { rows: number; properties: { id: string; name: string; type: string }[]; views: number; viewTypes: string[] };
}

export interface WorkspaceStats {
  workspaceId: string | null;
  workspaceName: string;
  /** Every live item (pages, databases, rows, folders, custom). */
  total: number;
  pages: number;
  databases: number;
  rows: number;
  folders: number;
  custom: number;
  topLevel: number;
  favorites: number;
  trashed: number;
  maxDepth: number;
  lastEdited: { pageId: string; title: string; updatedAt: string } | null;
  /** With content: true — totals read from every page's text. */
  content?: {
    scanned: number;
    words: number;
    characters: number;
    blocks: number;
    todos: { total: number; done: number; open: number };
    longest: { pageId: string; title: string; words: number }[];
    readingMinutes: number;
  };
}

/** What the window shows right now (app.state). */
export interface AppState {
  activePageId: string;
  activeTitle: string;
  focusedPaneId: string;
  panes: {
    id: string;
    focused: boolean;
    maximized: boolean;
    activeTab: string;
    tabs: { id: string; pageId: string; title: string; kind: "home" | "page" | "web" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom"; active: boolean }[];
  }[];
  openTabs: number;
  leftSidebar: { open: boolean; tab: string };
  rightSidebar: { open: boolean; tab: string };
  assistantOpen: boolean;
  /** Open overlay ("palette", "settings", …) or "". */
  overlay: string;
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  online: boolean;
  window: { width: number; height: number };
  workspaceId: string | null;
  history: { canGoBack: boolean; canGoForward: boolean };
}

export interface PageInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  cover: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  /** Custom node type id, for kind "custom" (see nodes.listTypes). */
  nodeType?: string;
  parentId: string;
  /** For rows: the database they belong to. */
  databaseId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  deleted?: boolean;
}

export interface PageContent {
  page: PageInfo;
  format: "markdown" | "text";
  content: string;
  /** Child pages (and database rows) directly under this page. */
  children: PageInfo[];
}

export interface DatabaseInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  parentId: string;
  rowCount: number;
  properties: string[];
}

export interface DatabasePropertyInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  options?: { id: string; name: string; color: string }[];
  /** Number properties (and number formulas): number | commas | percent | dollar | euro | pound | yen. */
  format?: string;
  /** Formula properties: the formula source. */
  formula?: string;
  /** Formula properties: the type the results have (number, text, checkbox, date). */
  resultType?: string;
  /** Date and date-formula display: relative | short | long | iso. */
  dateFormat?: string;
  /** Formula properties: why the formula fails, if it does. */
  error?: string;
  /** Number properties (and number formulas): how the value is shown, when not as a plain number. */
  display?: { style: "number" | "bar" | "ring" | "rating" | "heat"; color?: string; max?: number; showNumber?: boolean };
}

export interface DatabaseSchemaInfo {
  databaseId: string;
  title: string;
  titleName: string;
  /** Present (true) when the database is locked: row writes are refused. */
  locked?: boolean;
  properties: DatabasePropertyInfo[];
  views: { id: string; name: string; type: string }[];
}

/** A filter rule, or a nested and/or group of rules (advanced filters). */
export type DatabaseFilterNode =
  | { id: string; property: string; op: string; value?: unknown }
  | { id: string; mode: "and" | "or"; items: DatabaseFilterNode[] };

/** Chart view settings; property ids are returned as names. */
export interface DatabaseChartInfo {
  kind?: "bar" | "column" | "line" | "area" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter" | "funnel" | "radar" | "heatmap" | "number";
  x?: string;
  dateBucket?: "day" | "week" | "month" | "quarter" | "year";
  aggregate?: "count" | "countValues" | "countUnique" | "sum" | "average" | "median" | "min" | "max";
  y?: string;
  series?: string;
  stacked?: boolean;
  normalize?: boolean;
  cumulative?: boolean;
  sort?: "default" | "label" | "labelDesc" | "value" | "valueDesc";
  limit?: number;
  omitEmpty?: boolean;
  smooth?: boolean;
  labels?: boolean;
  legend?: boolean;
  grid?: boolean;
  palette?: string;
  height?: number;
  goal?: number;
  yMin?: number;
  yMax?: number;
  format?: string;
  title?: string;
  zoom?: boolean;
  zoomSlider?: boolean;
  xTitle?: string;
  yTitle?: string;
  xLabels?: boolean;
  yLabels?: boolean;
  labelAngle?: number;
  logScale?: boolean;
  labelContent?: "value" | "percent" | "name" | "nameValue" | "namePercent";
  labelPosition?: "inside" | "outside";
  colorBy?: "category" | "single";
  color?: string;
  curve?: "straight" | "smooth" | "step";
  points?: boolean;
  gradient?: boolean;
  donutWidth?: number;
  other?: boolean;
  aggregate2?: "count" | "countValues" | "countUnique" | "sum" | "average" | "median" | "min" | "max";
  /** Property name. */
  y2?: string;
  legendPosition?: "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right";
  tooltip?: "group" | "item" | "off";
  goalLabel?: string;
  emptyText?: string;
}

export interface DatabaseViewInfo {
  databaseId: string;
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: "table" | "board" | "gallery" | "list" | "calendar" | "chart" | "custom";
  filters: { id: string; property: string; op: string; value?: unknown }[];
  filterMode: "and" | "or";
  /** Advanced filter tree, combined (AND) with `filters`. */
  advanced?: { mode: "and" | "or"; items: DatabaseFilterNode[] };
  sorts: { property: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
  /** Visible properties, in order (the title column first). */
  visible: string[];
  hidden: string[];
  groupBy?: string;
  hiddenGroups?: string[];
  collapsedGroups?: string[];
  hideEmptyGroups?: boolean;
  colorColumns?: boolean;
  dateProperty?: string;
  cardPreview?: "cover" | "none";
  cardSize?: "small" | "medium" | "large";
  wrap?: boolean;
  widths?: Record<string, number>;
  calcs?: Record<string, string>;
  showFilterBar?: boolean;
  /** Rows shown before "Load more". */
  limit?: number;
  showIcons?: boolean;
  /** Tab icon (emoji or icon value). */
  icon?: string;
  /** Set when a database block created this view for itself: the block id. It shows only in that block. */
  owner?: string;
  /** Where row pages open: modal (default) | side | tab | current. */
  openIn?: "modal" | "side" | "tab" | "current";
  rowNumbers?: boolean;
  chart?: DatabaseChartInfo;
  /** Custom views: the HTML/CSS/JS rendered in a sandboxed frame. */
  custom?: { html: string; height?: number };
}

export interface DatabaseRowInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Values keyed by property name; select options are returned by name; formulas hold their result. */
  values: Record<string, unknown>;
  updatedAt: string;
  /** Formula errors for this row, by property name. */
  errors?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface WorkspaceInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  pageCount: number;
  current: boolean;
}

export interface TabInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: "page" | "home" | "web";
  paneId: string;
  active: boolean;
}

export interface PaneInfo {
  id: string;
  tabs: string[];
  activeTabId: string;
  focused: boolean;
  maximized: boolean;
}

export interface LayoutInfo {
  panes: PaneInfo[];
  /** Nested split tree: { type: "pane", id } | { type: "split", dir, sizes, children }. */
  tree: unknown;
  leftOpen: boolean;
  rightOpen: boolean;
  railOpen: boolean;
  leftWidth: number;
  rightWidth: number;
  leftTab: string;
  rightTab: string;
}

export interface SearchHitInfo {
  pageId: string;
  title: string;
  snippet: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface Preferences {
  theme: "light" | "dark" | "system";
  editorFont: "serif" | "sans";
  fontSize: number;
  lineHeight: number;
  pageWidth: number;
  fullWidth: boolean;
  autosaveDelay: number;
  spellcheck: boolean;
  reduceMotion: boolean;
  showStats: boolean;
}

export interface CssSnippet {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  css: string;
  enabled: boolean;
}

export interface ComponentStyle {
  css?: string;
  rules?: string;
  hidden?: boolean;
}

export interface Look {
  tokens: { light: Record<string, string>; dark: Record<string, string> };
  components: Record<string, ComponentStyle>;
  css: CssSnippet[];
}

/** The base look plus every layer. */
export interface Customizations extends Look {
  version: 2;
  layers: LayerInfo[];
  sidebar?: { groups: { id: string; tabs: string[]; active: string; size: number }[] };
}

/** A switchable bundle of customizations (see appearance.listLayers). */
export interface LayerInfo extends Look {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  source: "assistant" | "user" | "plugin";
  enabled: boolean;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
  permissions: string[];
  chatId?: string;
  pluginId?: string;
  sidebarTabs: SidebarTabDefinition[];
  statusWidgets: StatusWidgetDefinition[];
  blockTypes: BlockTypeDefinition[];
  nodeTypes: NodeTypeDefinition[];
}

export interface TokenInfo {
  name: string;
  group: "color" | "font" | "shape" | "layout";
  description: string;
  light: string;
  dark: string;
}

export interface ComponentInfo {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  selector: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface CommandInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  description?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
}

export interface WebSearchResult {
  query: string;
  engine: string;
  results: { title: string; url: string; snippet: string }[];
}

export interface WebPage {
  url: string;
  finalUrl: string;
  title: string;
  contentType: string;
  /** Readable text (Markdown-ish) extracted from the page. */
  content: string;
  truncated: boolean;
  links?: { text: string; url: string }[];
}

export interface HttpResponse {
  status: number;
  statusText: string;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  /** Body as text, or base64 when `encoding` is "base64". */
  body: string;
  encoding: "text" | "base64";
  url: string;
}

export interface PluginInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  author: string;
  description: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  source: string;
  permissions: string[];
  problem?: string;
}

export interface PluginSourceInfo {
  manifest: Record<string, unknown>;
  code: string;
  styles: string;
}

export interface PanelAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  primary?: boolean;
}

/** manifest.json — see docs/plugins/manifest.md. */
export interface PluginManifest {
  /** Reverse-domain id, e.g. "com.example.word-goal". Never changes between versions. */
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Semver, e.g. "1.2.0". Must match the GitHub release tag (with or without "v"). */
  version: string;
  /** SDK the plugin was built against, e.g. "2.0.0". */
  sdkVersion: string;
  /** Oldest Noteral version the plugin works with. */
  minAppVersion?: string;
  description?: string;
  author?: string;
  authorUrl?: string;
  /** "owner/name" of the GitHub repository that publishes releases. */
  repo?: string;
  /** Bundled script, usually "main.js". */
  entry: string;
  permissions: string[];
  contributes?: {
    commands?: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description?: string; keywords?: string }>;
    statusItems?: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>;
    panels?: Array<{ id: string; title: string }>;
  };
}

export interface StatusOptions {
  /** Tooltip shown on hover. */
  title?: string;
}

/** Content of a sidebar tab or similar surface: Markdown with buttons, or an HTML view. */
export interface ViewContent {
  markdown?: string;
  actions?: PanelAction[];
  html?: string;
}

export interface SidebarTabDefinition {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  view: ViewContent;
}

export interface StatusWidgetDefinition {
  id: string;
  text?: string;
  tooltip?: string;
  icon?: string;
  html?: string;
  width?: number;
  side: "left" | "right";
  order: number;
  command?: string;
}

export interface BlockTypeDefinition {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  keywords?: string[];
  html: string;
  defaultData?: unknown;
  height?: number;
}

export interface NodeTypeDefinition {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  html: string;
  defaultData?: unknown;
}

export interface ContributionOwnerInfo {
  kind: "plugin" | "layer";
  id: string;
  name: string;
}

export interface SidebarTabInfo {
  /** Key used by sidebar.openTab / setLayout: built-in id or "<owner kind>:<owner id>:<tab id>". */
  key: string;
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  builtin: boolean;
  owner?: ContributionOwnerInfo;
  kind: "builtin" | "markdown" | "html";
}

export interface SidebarInfo {
  open: boolean;
  width: number;
  groups: { tabs: string[]; active: string; size: number }[];
  tabs: SidebarTabInfo[];
}

export interface StatusWidgetInfo {
  /** Use this key with statusBar.setItem / statusBar.configure (built-ins: "builtin:<id>"). */
  key: string;
  id: string;
  /** Where it shows now (after the layout). */
  side: "left" | "center" | "right";
  order: number;
  builtin: boolean;
  text?: string;
  kind: "builtin" | "text" | "html";
  owner?: ContributionOwnerInfo;
  /** Hidden by the layout (built-ins "local", "page" and "clock" start hidden). */
  hidden?: boolean;
  width?: number | string;
}

export interface StatusItemLayoutInfo {
  hidden?: boolean;
  side?: "left" | "center" | "right";
  order?: number;
  width?: number | string;
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
}

export interface StatusBarLayoutInfo {
  hidden?: boolean;
  separator: "none" | "line" | "dot" | "slash" | "space";
  gap?: number;
  height?: number;
  padding?: number;
  fontSize?: number;
  items: Record<string, StatusItemLayoutInfo>;
  /** Every item with its effective placement. */
  widgets: StatusWidgetInfo[];
}

export interface BlockTypeInfo {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  owner: ContributionOwnerInfo;
}

export interface NodeTypeInfo {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** "full": the view is the whole page. "page": a page head above the view. */
  layout: "full" | "page";
  owner: ContributionOwnerInfo;
}

export interface MenuItemInfo {
  key: string;
  id: string;
  menu: "page" | "tree" | "block" | "tab" | "status";
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  command: string;
  danger?: boolean;
  owner: ContributionOwnerInfo;
}

export interface SettingFieldInfo {
  key: string;
  type: "toggle" | "text" | "textarea" | "number" | "slider" | "select" | "color";
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  default?: unknown;
  options?: { value: string; label: string }[];
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  placeholder?: string;
  section?: string;
}

export interface HomeViewSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  kind: "template" | "custom";
  isDefault: boolean;
  widgets?: number;
  background: string;
}

export interface HomeWidgetInfo {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  title?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface HomeViewInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  title: string;
  width: "narrow" | "wide" | "full";
  gap: "tight" | "normal" | "roomy";
  cards: "glass" | "solid" | "outline" | "flat";
  radius: number;
  shadow: "none" | "soft" | "lifted";
  font: "serif" | "sans" | "mono";
  valign: "top" | "center";
  accent?: string;
  css?: string;
  widgets: HomeWidgetInfo[];
  /** Background presets that home.setBackground accepts. */
  backgrounds: string[];
}

export interface HomeWidgetTypeInfo {
  type: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  w: number;
  h: number;
}

export interface AskResult {
  /** The typed answer, or the chosen labels joined with ", ". */
  answer: string;
  choices: string[];
  cancelled: boolean;
}

export interface LogEntryInfo {
  at: number;
  level: "info" | "warn" | "error";
  message: string;
}

export interface PluginTestResult {
  ok: boolean;
  status: "ready" | "failed" | "timeout";
  error?: string;
  logs: { level: string; message: string }[];
  commands: string[];
  contributions: { sidebarTabs: string[]; statusWidgets: string[]; blockTypes: string[]; nodeTypes: string[]; menuItems: string[]; settings: string[]; panels: string[]; statusItems: string[] };
  /** App API methods the code called. */
  calls: string[];
  /** Write calls that were skipped during the test. */
  skipped: string[];
}

export interface PluginInstallResult extends PluginInfo {
  test?: PluginTestResult;
  health: { status: "ready" | "failed" | "starting" | "stopped"; error?: string; logs: { level: string; message: string }[] };
}

/** Something with editable text, from source.list (assistant). */
export interface SourceEntry {
  /** Pass to source.get / source.edit, e.g. "status:pomodoro", "home:<viewId>/<widgetId>". */
  target: string;
  kind: "sidebar" | "status" | "block" | "node" | "css" | "component" | "home" | "homeview" | "plugin";
  title: string;
  /** Layer id ("base" = the app's own customizations), plugin id, or "home". */
  owner: string;
  /** Text fields and their length in characters. */
  fields: Record<string, number>;
  /** False for plugin-owned items: change them with plugins.edit. */
  editable: boolean;
}
```
